articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary: Microsoft drops a nuclear payload of 167 vulnerabilities including a SharePoint zero-day and Windows Defender's 'BlueHammer' weakness. April showers bring security nightmares.

articles.title: 20-Year-Old Malware Rewrites History of Cyber Sabotage
articles.summary: Windows RPC architecture has a massive unpatched flaw with five different exploit paths for privilege escalation. Microsoft's response: *crickets*.

articles.title: Brazilian LofyGang Resurfaces After Three Years With Minecraft LofyStealer Campaign
articles.summary: Critical GitHub RCE vulnerability allows remote code execution with a single git push command. When even your version control system can't be trusted, we've reached peak irony.

articles.title: What is Claude Mythos: a new technological revolution or a marketing myth?
articles.summary: Hugging Face's robotics platform LeRobot has a critical unpatched RCE flaw. Because apparently we needed our AI overlords to be hackable too.

articles.title: The Internet Still Works: SmugMug Powers Online Photography
articles.summary: Congress scrambles to pass another insufficient 702 reauthorization bill as FISA surveillance powers expire. Same surveillance state, new fig leaf.

articles.title: CIA Ran MK-ULTRA Experiments on Prisoners of War in U.S. Custody, Declassified Docs Confirm
articles.summary: Four Democrats hold the keys to Trump's domestic spying dreams as warrantless surveillance hangs in the balance. Democracy's fate decided by a handful of fence-sitters, as usual.

articles.title: Don't pay Vect a ransom - your data's likely already wiped out
articles.summary: Declassified docs finally confirm CIA ran MK-ULTRA experiments on North Korean POWs in US custody. The horror show was even worse than we thought.

articles.title: Researchers Discover Critical GitHub CVE-2026-3854 RCE Flaw Exploitable via Single Git Push
articles.summary: Medical device giant Medtronic and utility tech firm Itron both admit to security breaches in Friday document dumps. Nothing says 'we're screwed' like a Friday news dump.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Leaks Data of Udemy, Zara, 7-Eleven in Salesforce Linked Breach
articles.summary: Medtronic confirms breach after ShinyHunters claims theft of 9+ million records. When your pacemaker company gets pwned, that's what we call a cardiac event.

articles.title: Daily Hacker News for 2026-04-24
articles.summary: TeamPCP supply chain campaign returns from 26-day hiatus with simultaneous hits on Checkmarx, Bitwarden CLI, and xinference PyPI. These kids don't take breaks, they take scalps.
